title: Pulp and Periapical Biology: The Foundations of Personalized Endodontics
html: This article seeks to provide a perspective for future developments of endodontic care delivery, based on disease burden und contemporary clinical frameworks. Indeed, endodontic care has traditionally focused on the management of local disease conditions and long-term function. Here the concept of P4 Medicine (predictive, preventive, personalized, and participatory) may offer a strategic opportunity to reframe endodontics as driven by the notion of risk and its management. Based on data available for caries, the occurrence of untreated pulpal disease is likely substantial, leading to about 50% prevalence of apical periodontitis (AP).
